_note: Sample data in TMDB v3 response shape for previews and tests. Not real titles. poster_path/backdrop_path are null; the prototype draws gradient art from the _ui colours instead.

movies.title: Neon Tide
movies.overview: When a coastal megacity floods overnight, a salvage diver discovers the water is carrying signals from a future that hasn’t happened yet.
movies.tagline: The ocean remembers everything.

movies.title: The Last Lantern
movies.overview: A lamplighter’s apprentice must carry the last flame across a kingdom where night has stopped ending.
movies.tagline: Keep the light. Keep the way.

movies.title: Quiet Orbit
movies.overview: An estranged mother and daughter share a cramped research station when a solar storm cuts them off from Earth.
movies.tagline: Two hundred miles up, nobody hears you apologise.

movies.title: Paper Tigers
movies.overview: Three retired stunt performers plan one last heist on the film studio that wrote them out of history.
movies.tagline: Bad plans. Worse partners.

movies.title: Velvet Static
movies.overview: A late-night radio host falls for a caller who seems to know tomorrow’s headlines.
movies.tagline: Some frequencies only open at midnight.

movies.title: Ironbloom
movies.overview: A battle mech designed to clear forests starts planting them instead, and its pilot has to choose a side.
movies.tagline: Grown for war. Built for spring.

movies.title: Saffron Skies
movies.overview: A Kochi spice trader and a returning architect rebuild a crumbling family warehouse — and an old promise.
movies.tagline: Every monsoon brings someone home.

movies.title: Glass Harbor
movies.overview: A detective returns to her island hometown to investigate a disappearance the whole community witnessed and nobody reported.
movies.tagline: Everyone can see in. No one sees out.

movies.title: Moonlit Mechanics
movies.overview: A tiny repair robot discovers the moon’s night-light is running out and rallies a garage full of misfits to fix it.
movies.tagline: Fixing the moon, one bolt at a time.

movies.title: Red Meridian
movies.overview: Along a disputed mountain border, two radio operators on opposite sides begin a forbidden correspondence.
movies.tagline: Two voices. One frequency. No ceasefire.

movies.title: Afterparty Protocol
movies.overview: A tech launch party becomes a locked-room mystery when the company’s new AI goes missing.
movies.tagline: Nobody leaves until someone confesses.

movies.title: Hollow Crown Road
movies.overview: A stagecoach driver ferries a dying outlaw across the desert while three crews ride to collect the bounty.
movies.tagline: Every mile has a price.

movies.title: Starling Season
movies.overview: A small-town teacher coaches an unlikely girls’ cricket team all the way to the state finals.
movies.tagline: Learn to fly in formation.

movies.title: Undertow
movies.overview: Five friends rent a lake house for the weekend and learn why the locals never go near the water.
movies.tagline: Don’t swim after dark.

movies.title: Prism Heights
movies.overview: A courier making a late delivery finds each floor of a skyscraper stuck in a different decade.
movies.tagline: Every floor is a different year.

movies.title: Wildfire Waltz
movies.overview: A ballroom champion and a smoke-jumper are paired for a charity dance in a town waiting out fire season.
movies.tagline: Dance like the forest is listening.

movies.title: The Cartographer’s Daughter
movies.overview: A girl follows her missing father’s hand-drawn maps to places that aren’t on any other chart.
movies.tagline: Some maps draw you.

movies.title: Midnight Monsoon
movies.overview: A cab driver and a stranded witness race across a flooded Mumbai before a killer finds them.
movies.tagline: One storm. One night. One way out.

movies.title: Satellite Hearts
movies.overview: Two engineers fall for each other over the comms link between a ground station and a satellite only one of them can see.
movies.tagline: Love at 36,000 kilometres.

movies.title: The Brass Menagerie
movies.overview: A clockmaker’s mechanical animals come to life on Christmas Eve and set out to find their missing key.
movies.tagline: Wind them up. Let them go.

tv.name: Signal & Noise
tv.overview: A radio astronomer in the Atacama desert picks up a message addressed to her by name — and every season the signal gets closer.

tv.name: Chai & Chaos
tv.overview: Four flatmates turn a failing Bengaluru tea stall into the city’s most chaotic start-up.

tv.name: The Ninth Precinct
tv.overview: A night-shift detective unit polices a city district that officially doesn’t exist.

tv.name: Atlas Rising
tv.overview: When Earth’s orbital elevator starts to fall, a crew of maintenance engineers becomes the planet’s last line of defence.

tv.name: Bloom & Bone
tv.overview: A botanist inherits a walled garden where every plant grows from a buried memory.

tv.name: Kitchen Galaxy
tv.overview: Home cooks battle through themed rounds inspired by a different planet each week.
tv.tagline: Cook like the universe is watching.

tv.name: Night Shift Diaries
tv.overview: Interlinked stories of the people who keep a 24-hour hospital running after midnight.
tv.tagline: The city never sleeps. Neither do they.

tv.name: Pixel Pirates
tv.overview: A crew of video-game sprites escapes their console to hunt for the legendary Golden Cartridge.

tv.name: Hush Valley
tv.overview: In a mountain town where speaking above a whisper is forbidden, a new schoolteacher asks why.

tv.name: The Tidewater Files
tv.overview: A six-part look at the people rebuilding life along a shifting coastline.
tv.tagline: The coastline is changing. So are we.
